## 改了什么 / What changed

说明具体问题、改动后的行为和为什么有效；关联Issue（如有）。
Describe the problem, resulting behavior and why the change works. Link an issue if relevant.

## 怎么验证 / Validation

填写实际命令、结果和未运行的相关检查。界面改动附操作路径或截图；效率结论附同任务对照依据。
List commands and outcomes, plus relevant checks not run. Add interaction evidence for UI changes or comparison data for efficiency claims.

## 接口与来源（适用时） / Interfaces and sources, if relevant

说明对工具协议、SDK、已有会话或默认行为的影响，以及第三方代码、素材或新依赖的来源；没有涉及可删去本节。
Note effects on the protocol, SDK, saved sessions or defaults, and identify third-party sources or new dependencies. Remove this section when it does not apply.
